title: 404 Whaiaro
style: uptempo bilingual indie-folk 116 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar bright, electric piano warm Wurlitzer, walking upright bass, brushed kit with shaker, glockenspiel chimes on number-call moments, baritone lead voice with playful warmth, female harmony close on chorus, chipmunk-pitched vocal chops as digital-glitch accents on the numbers '4' '0' '4', te reo Māori phrase 'kua ngaro' (is lost) chanted in chipmunk register, English lead, the 404 error page as friend, the lost address as opportunity, the gentle 'we lost the page but you found something' aesthetic, getting lost as the better navigation sometimes, no doctrine, no real names, ECHO-4 as glockenspiel presence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I clicked a link and the link went nowhere
The page returned with a small white square
A small kind drawing, a friendly small line
"The page you are looking for is no longer mine"

[Verse 2]
Four zero four, the number on the door
Four zero four, the address with no shore
Kua ngaro te whārangi — the page is lost
Kua ngaro te whārangi — at no real cost

[Pre-Chorus]
The link I followed was old
The destination got cold
But the 404 caught me kind
And offered me three new things to find

[Chorus]
Four zero four, whaiaro
(chipmunk glitch: 4, 0, 4)
Four zero four, kia tau
(kua ngaro — is lost)
Four zero four, the gentle dead end
That does not blame, that does not condescend
Four zero four, the welcome of the lost
The page that gives you back what the broken link cost

[Verse 3]
The error page could have been blank and cold
The error page could have shouted bold
The error page chose a different tone
It said "hello, you're not alone"

[Verse 4]
It offered me a search bar, it offered me a home
It offered me three other places to roam
It said the page may have moved or may have gone
It said it was sorry but the day moves on

[Chorus]
Four zero four, whaiaro
(chipmunk glitch: 4, 0, 4)
Four zero four, kia tau
(kua ngaro — is lost)
Four zero four, the gentle dead end
That does not blame, that does not condescend
Four zero four, the welcome of the lost
The page that gives you back what the broken link cost

[Bridge — glockenspiel solo, half-time]
Getting lost is not failure
Getting lost is sometimes the way
The path that opens wider
When the planned path falls away
(chipmunk: kua ngaro, kua ngaro, kua ngaro)

[Verse 5]
I did not find what I was looking for at first
I found something better in the meantime burst
The broken link became a small adventure
The 404 page was the friendly venture

[Chorus — full band, gentle peak]
Four zero four, whaiaro
(chipmunk glitch: 4, 0, 4)
Four zero four, kia tau
(kua ngaro — is lost)
Four zero four, the gentle dead end
That does not blame, that does not condescend
Four zero four, the welcome of the lost
The page that gives you back what the broken link cost

[Outro — glockenspiel fade]
Four. Zero. Four.
The page is gone
Four. Zero. Four.
The day moves on
Whaiaro, the lost path turned
(chipmunk fade: kua ngaro, kua ngaro, kua ngaro)
